features.title: Execute compiled original libctru PICA draws through the standard guest GSP queue
scope: Resolve owned linear resources, retained PICA shader/state and tiled RGBA8 targets through standard guest GX commands.
Commit target bytes, counters and completion signals transactionally; preserve queue prefix and reject unsupported state.
Build an original normal-CRT ARM draw application and Wii U diagnostic without game patches.
Correct raw VFP push/pop under guest FPSCR controls without enabling unsupported arithmetic.
Consolidate shared portable runtime sources across host, test, validator and native build recipes.
acceptance: Two compiled guest command lists produce four exact indexed triangles and 97,200 covered fragments.
Analytic full-surface comparison passes for both targets and displayed RGB565 frames.
Normal and ASan/UBSan guest draw fixtures cover failure rollback, aliasing, permissions, retained state and completion.
Required portable CI and native RPX/WUHB builds pass.
CI retains exact source provenance and independently verifies every captured top/bottom pixel.
evidence: PR #57; tools/validate-libctru.py --application draw --wiiu --sanitize.
Host rendering and compilation only; physical Wii U execution is deferred.
No general shader ISA, TEV, depth/blend/sampling or GPU translation claim.

scope: Decouple bounded guest execution from the fixed 50,000 instructions per expensive host refresh while retaining real guest time, input and lifecycle responsiveness.

acceptance: Original tests cover instruction/time bounds, waiting/yield/no-progress exits and drawn-frame confirmation, with unchanged original guest pixel and own PASS checks.
